mapper.select: SELECT SEQ, WRITER_NO, TITLE, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(CONTENT, 4000, 1) AS CONTENT, REG_DT, MOD_DT FROM FEED WHERE WRITER_NO = #{writerNo} AND PASSWORD = #{password} ORDER BY REG_DT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FEED ( WRITER_NO, PASSWORD, TITLE, CONTENT, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{writerNo}, #{password}, #{title}, #{content}, SYSDATE )
